caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular textile with a symmetrical, repeating geometric pattern, primarily oriented horizontally. The textile has an off-white or beige background. It is divided into five major horizontal sections, each featuring a central diamond motif flanked by chevron (angle bracket) shapes in various colors, including red, orange, yellow, green, blue, and purple. Each main section is bordered above and below by sets of thin parallel lines in red, pink, and dark brown. Within the beige regions between these horizontal bands, there are scattered small, oval or diamond-shaped dots in colors such as purple, blue, green, orange, black, and red. The textile’s edges appear slightly frayed and irregular, and the overall composition is bordered by a blank, neutral background. The design is symmetrical along the vertical center axis, and the colors are bright and vivid, evenly distributed across the pattern.
title: Colcha
